summary: Phase 3 validation (Insights, Alerts, Analytics, Costs, Demo, System Health + /staff/system-check page). All 19 backend tests PASSED and frontend page fully renders with all required elements.

minor.issue: Field is named 'trial_conversion_pct_placeholder' in backend response, but spec mentions 'trial_conversion_pct'. Frontend should be aware of the '_placeholder' suffix (matches the 'mrr_eur_placeholder' convention).

issues: Long label 'audit_log_entries' visually overlaps with 'notifications_unread' label on adjacent card (4-column grid is too narrow for the longest label). Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: staff_demo.py seed is NOT fully idempotent for clock_events count: uses random.sample(members, 7) and random shift hours, so total counts of 196 events / 28 shifts hold only because lengths are deterministic (14 days * 7 samples * 2 events) - confirmed in test.
staff_demo.py /clear deletes data only for DEMO_MERCHANT_ID which is good isolation - no risk of touching production merchants.
staff_analytics.py /costs/by-location depends on routes.staff_locations._haversine_m import - if events have no lat/lng, location attribution falls back silently. Acceptable for analytics.
All Mongo _id fields are correctly excluded via projection {_id: 0}.
All 5 new modules properly registered in router_registry.
